Th\u1ef1c hi\u1ec7n ch\u1ee7 tr\u01b0\u01a1ng c\u1ed5 ph\u1ea7n ho&aacute; c&aacute;c doanh nghi\u1ec7p Nh&agrave; n\u01b0\u1edbc c\u1ee7a Ch&iacute;nh ph\u1ee7, th&aacute;ng 9\/2003 C&ocirc;ng ty ti\u1ebfn h&agrave;nh c\u1ed5 ph\u1ea7n ho&aacute; th&agrave;nh l\u1eadp C&ocirc;ng ty C\u1ed5 ph\u1ea7n C\u01a1 kh&iacute; - X&acirc;y d\u1ef1ng giao th&ocirc;ng (Tracomeco).<\/p>","noidung_en":"<p><strong>The Transport Mechanical Construction Joint Stock Company (Tracomeco)<\/strong> was re-established under Decision No. 2863\/QD - BGTVT of the Ministry of Transport signed on September 10, 2002 on converting a State-owned enterprise into a Joint Stock Company.<\/p>\r\n\r\n<p>The predecessor of the Company was the <strong>RMK Contractor Company<\/strong>, established by the US in 1962 and was the largest construction machinery overhaul and steel structure manufacturing facility in Southeast Asia at that time. After 1975, facing the urgent need to build and develop the Southern transport mechanical industry, on the basis of the RMK Contractor Company taking over after the liberation, the State and the Ministry of Transport established the Construction Mechanical Factory with the function of repairing and assembling construction machinery, automobiles of all kinds, building and repairing ships, etc.<\/p>\r\n\r\n<p>Since then, the Company has changed its name many times and separated to establish new enterprises. In 1996, the Traffic Mechanical Company 2 was re-established as a Company with a Board of Directors. Implementing the Government&#39;s policy of equitizing state-owned enterprises, in September 2003, the Company equitized to establish the Traffic Mechanical - Construction Joint Stock Company (Tracomeco).<\/p>","noidung_cn":"","tags_vi":"","tags_en":"","tags_cn":"","seo_name":"ve-chung-toi-tracomeco","id_parent_muti":"","catasort":"7","icon":"1739847149_gt-noidung-1.png","icon_hover":null,"dowload":null,"dowload_text":"","duongdantin":"datafiles","ngaydang":"9686","capnhat":"0","soluotxem":"5","step":"1","giatien":"0","giakm":"0","seo_title_vi":"V\u1ec1 ch\u00fang t\u00f4i tracomeco","seo_title_en":"About us Tracomeco","seo_title_cn":"","seo_keywords_vi":"V\u1ec1 ch\u00fang t\u00f4i tracomeco","seo_keywords_en":"About us Tracomeco","seo_keywords_cn":"","seo_description_vi":"V\u1ec1 ch\u00fang t\u00f4i tracomeco","seo_description_en":"About us Tracomeco","seo_description_cn":null,"opt_km":"0","opt":"0","opt1":"0","opt2":"1","opt3":"0","opt4":"0","opt5":"0","top_video":"0","p1":"","p2":"0","p3":"","link_video":"","num_1":"0","num_2":"0","num_3":"0","num_4":"0","showhi":"1","tinh_nang":"","thuoc_tinh_1_vi":"","thuoc_tinh_1_en":"","thuoc_tinh_2_vi":"","thuoc_tinh_2_en":"","thuoc_tinh_3_vi":"","thuoc_tinh_3_en":"","gia_tri_1_vi":"","gia_tri_2_vi":"","gia_tri_3_vi":"","thongso_vi":"","thongso_en":"","thongtin_vi":"","thongtin_en":"","ngayden":"0","ngaydi":"0","id_tag_multi":"","noidung2_vi":"","noidung2_en":"","noidung2_cn":"","kieudang_vi":"","kieudang_en":"","kieudang_cn":null}]
